title: Convex Schema for Songs and Lyrics
description: Define the database schema for songs and their lyrics.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create `convex/schema.ts` with songs table: songs: defineTable({title: v.string(), artist: v.string(), youtubeId: v.string(), sourceLanguage: v.string(), createdAt: v.number()})

Add lyrics table with timestamps: lyrics: defineTable({songId: v.id("songs"), lineNumber: v.number(), startTime: v.number(), endTime: v.number(), original: v.string(), transliteration: v.string(), hebrew: v.optional(v.string()), english: v.string()}).index("by_song", ["songId", "lineNumber"])
Run `bunx convex dev` to push schema
Verify tables appear in Convex dashboard
